using JSON3
using CUDA
import JACC
res = Dict{String,Any}()
res["julia"] = string(VERSION)
res["host"] = read(`hostname`, String)
res["nproc"] = strip(read(`nproc`, String))
function sh(cmd)
    try strip(read(pipeline(ignorestatus(`bash -c $cmd`); stderr = stdout), String)) catch e "ERR " * first(split(sprint(showerror, e), "\n")) end
end
res["scontrol_job"] = sh("scontrol show job \$SLURM_JOB_ID 2>&1 | grep -E 'TimeLimit|NumCPUs|AllocTRES|Gres' | head -5")
res["nvidia_smi"] = sh("nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total,driver_version,compute_cap --format=csv 2>&1 | head -3")
try
    res["cuda_pkg"] = string(pkgversion(CUDA))
    res["cuda_runtime"] = string(CUDA.runtime_version())
    res["cuda_driver"] = string(CUDA.driver_version())
    dev = CUDA.device()
    res["device"] = CUDA.name(dev)
    res["capability"] = string(CUDA.capability(dev))
    res["total_mem_gb"] = CUDA.totalmem(dev) / 2^30
    res["max_shared_per_block"] = CUDA.attribute(dev, CUDA.DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_MAX_SHARED_MEMORY_PER_BLOCK)
    res["max_regs_per_block"] = CUDA.attribute(dev, CUDA.DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_MAX_REGISTERS_PER_BLOCK)
    res["sm_count"] = CUDA.attribute(dev, CUDA.DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_MULTIPROCESSOR_COUNT)
    function addk!(y, x, n)
        i = (blockIdx().x - 1) * blockDim().x + threadIdx().x
        if i <= n; y[i] += x[i]; end
        return nothing
    end
    x = CUDA.ones(Float64, 1000); y = CUDA.zeros(Float64, 1000)
    k = @cuda launch=false addk!(y, x, 1000)
    res["maxthreads_simple_kernel"] = CUDA.maxthreads(k)
    @cuda threads=256 blocks=4 addk!(y, x, 1000)
    CUDA.synchronize()
    res["kernel_ok"] = sum(Array(y)) == 1000.0
catch e
    res["cuda_error"] = first(split(sprint(showerror, e), "\n"))
end
try
    res["jacc_backend"] = string(JACC.default_backend())
catch e
    res["jacc_error"] = first(split(sprint(showerror, e), "\n"))
end
println(JSON3.write(res))
